def place_knights(n):
    knights = []
    x, y = 1, 1
    dx, dy = 1, 1

    while len(knights) < n:
        knights.append((x, y))
        x += dx
        y += dy
        if x > n:
            x = 1
            y += 1
            dx, dy = -dx, -dy

    return knights
